pipeline.title: Werewolf transforms into Ambros via reverse merger to support phase 3 push for rare disease drug
pipeline.summary: Werewolf Therapeutics’ hunt for strategic alternatives has ended. Ambros Therapeutics has agreed to merge with Werewolf in an all-stock deal and has raised $150 million, positioning the biotech to take its lead rare disease drug candidate through to a filing for approval.

pipeline.title: Boehringer places phase 1 study of investigational drug on hold to examine ‘safety event’
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has suspended a phase 1 trial of an investigational small molecule drug while it seeks to understand a “safety event,” although the German pharma isn't shedding light on the nature of the incident for now.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—China's IIT scrutiny; Daiichi Sankyo, AZ ph. 3 win; Leo, Tanabe's dermatology deal
pipeline.summary: China's investigator-initiated trials, once praised for their speediness, have been drawn into scrutiny for a lack of transparency. AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo's Enhertu earned a win in a phase 3 non-small cell lung cancer trial. Tanabe Pharma secured a $435 million payout for

pipeline.title: Merck-Moderna cancer vaccine win spurs stock jump, speculation of Keytruda-like impact
pipeline.summary: As the dust settles on phase 3 data that added $45 billion to Moderna’s market cap, analysts have begun to ask a question that could define cancer care in the coming years: Can use of the vaccine be as broad as Keytruda?

pipeline.title: Pursuing patient options, Novo kicks off trial testing smaller doses of Wegovy pill
pipeline.summary: Just eight months after it introduced its Wegovy pill, Novo Nordisk is testing the GLP-1 in smaller doses in the phase 3 OASIS 5 study.

pipeline.title: SK strikes settlement with MSN over future Xcopri generic: reports
pipeline.summary: For the first time, SK Biopharmaceuticals has reached a settlement with a generics manufacturer that has applied for FDA approval of a copycat version of its epilepsy treatment Xcopri, local news outlets report. SK’s deal with India’s MSN Laboratories will allow the Korean compan

pipeline.title: Developing a Global Clinical Trial Strategy for Emerging Biotechs
pipeline.summary: Discussing how small biotechs can accelerate clinical development with fit-for-purpose global clinical trial strategies.

pipeline.title: Tolerance Bio jumps into phase 2 with $260M deal for thymus-targeting fusion protein
pipeline.summary: Tolerance Bio has vaulted into the clinic by agreeing to pay NeoImmuneTech up to $260 million for rights to a fusion protein in certain thymus-related indications in the Americas and Europe.

pipeline.title: Merck, Moderna’s personalized cancer vaccine slows recurrence in phase 3, setting up approval push
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. and Moderna's personalized mRNA cancer vaccine has successfully lengthened recurrence-free survival when paired with Keytruda for patients with high-risk skin cancer. The phase 3 win sets the partners up to potentially seek accelerated approval.

pipeline.title: Kolon TissueGene shrinks workforce after pivotal osteoarthritis trial miss
pipeline.summary: Following a phase 3 knee osteoarthritis failure that its CEO acknowledged caused “great disappointment and concern,” Kolon TissueGene is laying off 37 employees at its Maryland headquarters.

pipeline.title: Regeneron's Pasatru scores FDA approval in ultra-rare bone lesions disorder
pipeline.summary: Regeneron's Pasatru has crossed the finish line with FDA approval after more than ten years of development. The drug is only the second approved treatment for FOP, an ultra-rare genetic condition that causes patients' soft tissues to turn to bone.

pipeline.title: Pharma marketers need a share-of-answer strategy before AI spend
pipeline.summary: AI is changing how HCPs seek answers. Pharma marketers need a new strategy.

pipeline.title: Daiichi Sankyo promotes Ken Keller to lead new commercialization unit
pipeline.summary: Daiichi Sankyo is promoting Ken Keller to lead a new globally integrated commercialization unit, putting the executive in charge of a key pillar of its push to become a top five oncology company by 2035.

pipeline.title: Community Health Media drives 'credible medical expertise' through physician-led content
pipeline.summary: Education and insight company Community Health Media curates its content library by centering physicians as "the talent" and centering its content creation on insightful physician-led conversations.

pipeline.title: Lundbeck continues neuroscience evolution as CEO keeps company ‘punching above its weight’
pipeline.summary: Almost three years into his tenure as Lundbeck’s CEO, Charl van Zyl is confident the company can prove its mettle as a “neuroscience challenger” capable of “punching above its weight.”

pipeline.title: Shareholder pressures Capricor; Lilly dives deeper into vaccines
pipeline.summary: Kaos Capital wants a “governance reset” to alter the Duchenne cell therapy maker’s strategic course. Elsewhere, Bristol Myers furthered efforts to build an “AI-powered” discovery engine.

pipeline.title: How cost and perception could reshape the GLP-1 market
pipeline.summary: As Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk race for share, surveys show affordability and prescribing preferences may help decide the winners.

pipeline.title: Regeneron podcast turns science learnings into immersive experience
pipeline.summary: Regeneron's "Science Illuminated" podcast series transforms scientific topics into a calming, meditative-style video and audio experience.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Neumora shuffles leadership ahead of IND
pipeline.summary: Joshua Pinto, Ph.D., has been appointed chief executive officer of Neumora Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biotech with obesity and neuro assets.

pipeline.title: Roche earmarks $750M to double the size of its Oregon manufacturing facility
pipeline.summary: Roche will invest $750 million to double the size of its Genentech unit's manufacturing facility in Hillsboro, Oregon. The new outlay will support the construction of a fill-finish plant that will produce drug-delivery devices, such as prefilled syringes and auto-injectors. The f

pipeline.title: Xspray's Dasynoc approval bid foiled again by FDA's manufacturer concerns
pipeline.summary: Less than a year after the FDA turned down the resubmitted application for the company’s leukemia prospect Dasynoc, Xspray Pharma has again hit a wall at the U.S. regulator.

pipeline.title: Regeneron to challenge Ipsen as FDA clears bone disease drug
pipeline.summary: Pasatru’s approval sets up a market battle in a rare indication where the only available treatment has generated disappointing sales.

pipeline.title: Cancer vaccine win restores Wall Street’s faith in Moderna
pipeline.summary: Moderna gained $45 billion in market value in a single day, a surge that brought the company’s stock to levels not seen since 2024 — and saddled it with expectations that may be tough to meet.

pipeline.title: Ultragenyx, after setbacks, nabs first gene therapy approval
pipeline.summary: The clearance of Genglycos for a rare glycogen storage disease gives Ultragenyx a sellable voucher and momentum ahead of an eagerly anticipated study readout.

pipeline.title: Aurinia settles with Teva, helping stave off potential Lupkynis generic until late 2036

pipeline.title: B. Braun recalls IV solution from US, Canada hospitals on particle contamination concerns
pipeline.summary: B. Braun Medical—a maker of IV solutions for hospitals, among other products—has initiated a recall in the United States and Canada spurred by particulate contamination.

pipeline.title: Chai tees up Bristol Myers Squibb AI antibody discovery collab
pipeline.summary: A month after Chai Discovery tied up a major $400 million series C funding round, the AI drug discovery firm has teamed up with Bristol Myers Squibb.

pipeline.title: Lilly pens deal with Gateway Labs resident Amplitude for RNA vaccine platform for infectious disease
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has turned to one of its Gateway Labs residents to help the Big Pharma develop trans-amplifying RNA (taRNA) vaccines for infectious diseases.

pipeline.title: Why Pheast’s CEO has no regrets about transparent approach to R&D despite competitors circling
pipeline.summary: Pheast Therapeutics may have learned the hard way about the risks of competitors getting a glimpse of your heard-earned discoveries, but the immuno-oncology startup is so far sticking to its transparent approach.

pipeline.title: Meet Aletta: The first FDA approved robotic blood draw device
pipeline.summary: The FDA has approved Vitestro’s Aletta as the first standalone robotic device in the U.S. designed to draw blood without the need for hands-on human help.

pipeline.title: Lucid Group names leading Publicis Health exec as new CEO
pipeline.summary: Healthcare comms and commercialization agency Lucid Group has hired Eric Muller as its new chief executive officer.

pipeline.title: Boehringer Ingelheim again rises up rare disease reputation rankings
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has continued its rise up patient groups’ ranking of rare disease companies, adding to last year’s gains to cement its status toward the top of the leaderboards. But the German drugmaker failed to crack the top three of the full table, which the same three co

pipeline.title: Ultragenyx, after FDA speed bump, lands 1st gene therapy nod with green light in glycogen storage disease
pipeline.summary: If at first you don’t succeed in gene therapy, then try, try again, is the lesson Ultragenyx likely took home this week, pocketing its first FDA nod in the class a little over a year after a separate program stalled on manufacturing grounds.

pipeline.title: Amgen abandoning $500M+ Crohn’s collab won’t derail TScan’s pipeline strategy
pipeline.summary: TScan has told Fierce that its pipeline strategy remains unchanged despite Amgen walking away from a Crohn’s disease collaboration that had the potential for a windfall of half a billion dollars.

pipeline.title: Lilly’s long-acting insulin wins NICE blessing ahead of potential UK approval
pipeline.summary: Hundreds of thousands of patients with type 2 diabetes could eventually make the switch to a weekly insulin injection and reduce their annual injections by 85% after NICE, the U.K.’s drug cost watchdog, gave Lilly's Onswik its seal of approval for NHS coverage.

pipeline.title: Merck and Sarah Cannon team up to boost oncology trial efficiency
pipeline.summary: Oncology R&D organization Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) announced a collaboration with Merck & Co. to increase patient access to oncology trials at community-based sites in the U.S.

pipeline.title: Trump nominates policy aide Overton to lead FDA
pipeline.summary: Heidi Overton, a medical doctor and veteran of the America First think tank, currently serves as deputy director of the White House Domestic Policy Council.

pipeline.title: When is the new who: The importance of timing in HCP marketing
pipeline.summary: HCP marketers have spent years perfecting whom to reach. The harder question, and the one that decides whether a message lands, is when.

pipeline.title: Contractor SK Pharmteco heralds completion of 2 API plants in Ireland
pipeline.summary: The summer of the high-potency active pharmaceutical ingredient expansion continues, as yet another manufacturing specialist makes inroads to boost capacity for sensitive, in-demand drug ingredients.

pipeline.summary: After three months without a permanent leader in place, President Donald Trump has named his pick for the new commissioner of the FDA. Heidi Overton, M.D., Ph.D., currently a White House aide, will go before the Senate in an effort to secure the job of the country’s top drug regu

pipeline.title: Aurobindo unit, China API maker dinged in latest round of FDA warning letters
pipeline.summary: After receiving a checkered regulatory scorecard in 2024, Aurobindo’s sterile injectables and oncology unit is back in the FDA’s crosshairs.

pipeline.title: New Biotech-Academia Partnership Approaches to Empower the Drug Development Ecosystem
pipeline.summary: Addressing shifts in the global clinical development ecosystem and how academia and biotech can better partner to develop new therapies for patients.

pipeline.title: How Pharma Teams Evaluate Biotech Companies for Partnerships and Acquisitions
pipeline.summary: Addressing how interactions around partnerships or acquisitions differ from those of investment from biotech companies and how CMOs can support those conversations.

pipeline.title: Moderna and Merck cancer vaccine returns ‘landmark’ result in melanoma
pipeline.summary: At an interim data check, investigators of a key trial found the individualized mRNA treatment kept disease from returning and stopped its spread, sparking a surge in Moderna shares.

pipeline.title: Genetix kicks off sickle cell disease awareness campaign with NFL Alumni Association
pipeline.summary: Genetix Biotherapeutics is teaming up with the NFL Alumni Association for a U.S. awareness and education drive centered on sickle cell disease.

pipeline.title: Teva scores rare partial win in CMS price negotiation appeal
pipeline.summary: In challenging IRA price negotiations, Teva Pharmaceuticals has gained a partial win as the U.S. Court of Appeals for Washington, D.C., sent a previous ruling back to a lower court for further review. The challenge surrounds the way the CMS determines “bona fide marketing” for a

pipeline.title: A ‘renaissance for biomedicine’: human brain organoids model development for 5 years
pipeline.summary: Scientists’ ability to recapitulate the human brain in a dish has always been hindered by the inability to model the full capacity of the brain and its development through time.

pipeline.title: What did we learn from Big Pharma’s Q2 results?
pipeline.summary: Fierce editors break down Big Pharma’s second-quarter results, from AI and new leadership to the oral GLP-1 race and potential new blockbusters.

pipeline.title: BioMarin acquires experimental drug for rare bone disorder in $275M deal
pipeline.summary: The Alesta buyout helps restock BioMarin's pipeline with an asset it says could “reach our largest addressable patient population,” joining other muscle and skeletal disease treatments in development.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca scores in lung cancer; Sandoz inks a China deal
pipeline.summary: A combination of AstraZeneca’s Tagrisso and Hutchmed’s Orpathys extended survival for some lung cancer patients. Elsewhere, MapLight floated the idea of partnering on its autism drug.

pipeline.title: BioMarin bulks up bone unit with $275M Alesta buyout to challenge AstraZeneca
pipeline.summary: BioMarin Pharmaceutical has agreed to buy Alesta Therapeutics for $275 million upfront, positioning the biopharma to challenge AstraZeneca in the rare bone disease market.

pipeline.title: Craif raises $33M to boost work on its urine test for cancer
pipeline.summary: The AI biopharma Craif has raised $33 million in its series D funding round as it also adds a new exec, bringing its total capital raised to date to $88 million.

pipeline.title: Johnson & Johnson MedTech nabs Monarch Quest 3 update for lung cancer detection
pipeline.summary: Johnson & Johnson MedTech has been handed its fourth major software launch in the past 18 months for its Monarch bronchoscopy robot.

pipeline.title: Amylyx readies approval push after GLP-1 inhibitor halves blood sugar crashes in ph. 3 win
pipeline.summary: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals’ $35 million bet on the GLP-1 receptor antagonist avexitide appears to have paid off, with the molecule cutting the number of dangerous blood sugar crashes by more than half in patients with a rare endocrine disease.

pipeline.title: ‘Money has spoken’: Why Chinese biotech CEOs tell Fierce they’re unfazed about rising US tensions
pipeline.summary: You might assume Chinese biotechs are enduring sleepless nights worrying about whether the ramping up of rhetoric in the U.S. is putting their new financial gains in peril. But the companies Fierce spoke to remained unconcerned.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: J&J scores EU approval for Tecvayli-Darzalex combo
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Novo's Wegovy pill back on track as Lilly's momentum slows
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.
